purpose: Freeze the exact approved NEED_ANALYSIS_PLAN and COLLECTION_FRAME method rules before any PROD activation surface can enable real collection, so post-hoc question-to-need mapping, ranking, coverage thresholds, channel-concentration rules or stop rules cannot be changed after responses begin.
amendment_rule: Any material method amendment must occur while collection and PROD activation remain disabled, use a new approved collection-frame identity/version as applicable, and create a new dual SHA-256 lock before collection can resume.
